svg.title: Biotron - top view, labelled
svg.desc: The Playtronica Biotron board, shaped like a plant cell: USB-C connector at the top, two LED arcs, the microcontroller in the centre, a light sensor below it, two leaf-pad clip points, and the BOOT contacts for firmware updates.
svg.text: blink during calibration, pulse with the music
short for the manual firmware reset
